_comment2: This file is safe to COMMIT: keep secrets out of it by using ${VAR} references, which are resolved from the environment or .env at startup.
_comment4: Keys starting with _ are ignored by the loader.

auth._comment: Generate a client token with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(16).toString('hex'))"

keys._comment: Preferred: leave this as the env reference. Alternatively point keysFile at a gitignored JSON file with { "default": "...", "models": {} }.

allowlist._comment: Only sources matching these prefixes may use the proxy. Judged against x-forwarded-for when trustForwarded is on (needed behind NAT).

reasoning._comment: Tier per model. null / "" / "default" = forward NO reasoning_effort, i.e. the provider's own default.
reasoning._comment2: Allowed: none | low | medium | high | xhigh | max
